svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A shroud: a 3 mm band 26 mm deep round the outline in the front view,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: closed on the outside by a 2 mm face; open on the frame side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The outline clears both sprockets by 17 mm and the tensioner over

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its full 45 mm of travel. 362 mm long, 192 mm tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 4.5 mm holes in the face: 17 mm ahead of and 29 mm below the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drive axle; 32 mm behind and 12 mm below the plate shaft.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print face down, no supports; split in two at mid-length and glue

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: if your printer bed is under 370 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spacers: 8 mm tube, 38.5 mm (drive end) and 39.5 mm (plate end).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: two M5 x 45 screws through the face and spacers into the tapped

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: holes in the drop plate and bearing plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: turn the wheel: nothing touches the guard.
